name: Quick Buy One Get One Free
author: Appalify

sections.description:
Create BOGO offers to boost your WooCommerce stores conversion rate.

Features
– buy a get a free
– buy a get b free
– set the minimum quantity that a users has to buy in order to receive a free item
– set the max amount of free items per cart
– set the amount of free items a user gets per amount of paid items
– display a message in shop

Turn your WooCommerce store into a sales machine with our Quick Buy One Get One Free extension. Whether you want to reward loyal customers, clear inventory, or launch irresistible offers, this plugin gives you full flexibility to set up BOGO deals that increase conversions and boost revenue.

From classic “Buy One, Get One Free” promotions to more advanced deals like “Buy 2, Get 1 Free” or “Buy A, Get B Free,” you can create dynamic offers that keep your customers coming back.

Requirements:
– WordPress
– Woocommerce
sections.installation:
Installing “BOGO” can be done either by searching for “BOGO” via the “Plugins > Add New” screen in your WordPress dashboard, or by using the following steps:

  1. Download the plugin via WordPress.org
  2. Upload the ZIP file through the ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload’ screen in your WordPress dashboard
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
